property_summary: For any owner-invoked Command sending msg.value to a callee whose fallback is payable and records received amount, the reference forwards exactly msg.value (so address(c).balance decreases by msg.value and the callee's recorded received equals msg.value); the mutant may forward the entire contract balance, causing the callee to observe/receive more than msg.value (violating the equality).
change_summary: Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data) with a direct low-level call that forwards all contract balance instead of msg.value, changing transferred value semantics.
